# Local Answer

> Professional HVAC, plumbing, and electrical services in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas.

Local Answer provides licensed, insured home services across 50+ cities in the DFW metroplex. Available 24/7 for emergencies with upfront pricing and same-day service.

## Services

- Plumbing: Emergency plumbing, drain cleaning, leak detection, water heater repair & installation, pipe repair, fixture installation
- Cooling: AC repair, AC installation, central air service, ductless mini-splits, AC maintenance
- Heating: Furnace repair, heating installation, heat pump service, heating maintenance
- Electrical: Panel upgrades, wiring repair, outlet installation, lighting, surge protection

## Service Area

Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex including: Dallas, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Richardson, Garland, Irving, Arlington, Fort Worth, Denton, Lewisville, Carrollton, Rowlett, Kennedale, Mesquite, Grand Prairie, Flower Mound, and 40+ additional cities across Collin, Dallas, Denton, Tarrant, and Rockwall counties.
